item.title: Draft Ministerial Ordinance on Registration and Operating Standards for Fee-Based Homes for the Elderly
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare published a draft amending ministerial ordinance on 2026-11-13, with a stated comment deadline of 2026-12-13 16:00 JST. It would amend the Enforcement Regulations of the Act on Social Welfare for the Elderly (Ministry of Health and Welfare Ordinance No. 28 of 1963) and related ordinances in connection with partial implementation of the Act Partially Amending the Social Welfare Act and Other Acts (Act No. 5 of 2026), planned for December 1, 2027; the underlying elderly welfare law is Act No. 133 of 1963. For prefectural registration of fee-based homes serving residents needing particular protection, including those with moderate-to-severe care needs, the proposed standards would prohibit contractual requirements to use affiliated care providers, home-care support providers, medical institutions, visiting nursing providers or pharmacies, forced changes of physician or care manager, and rent discounts linked to using those providers. The draft also sets out registration application documents, including explanations of referral-fee arrangements, and broadly similar notification procedures for homes outside the registration category. Some operating requirements would broadly mirror registration standards, with transitional measures for certain provisions; their duration is not specified in the supplied excerpts. item.title: Draft Cabinet Order on registered-facility care support and transitional arrangements
item.description: AI summary: The draft Cabinet Order would amend related orders to implement part of the Act Partially Amending the Social Welfare Act and Other Acts (Act No. 51 of 2026), including changes concerning the Social Welfare Act (Act No. 45 of 1951) and Long-Term Care Insurance Act (Act No. 123 of 1997). It would add registered-facility care support and registered-facility preventive care support to eligible social welfare corporation activities, provide exceptional care-plan benefits where insured persons receive designated services without presenting insurance documentation for emergencies or other unavoidable reasons, and include the services in specified high-cost benefit calculations and national funding arrangements. Proposed transitional provisions would deem existing designated in-home care support providers and designated in-home preventive care support providers designated for the corresponding new services for a period whose length is not stated in the excerpt. The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's Dementia Policy and Community Care Promotion Division, Health and Welfare Bureau for the Elderly, published the consultation on 2026-11-13, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-12 00:00 JST. Promulgation is planned for mid-January 2027 and commencement for 2028-12-01, except that some miscellaneous amendments would take effect upon promulgation; these dates are proposals, not confirmed commencement. item.title: MAFF issues corrective order over misuse of the Omi Beef geographical indication
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-13, the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) announced a corrective order against Sogo Omi Beef Trading Co., Ltd. under Article 5 of the Act on Protection of the Names of Specific Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Products and Foodstuffs (Act No. 84 of 2014). MAFF found that, at least from December 2025 through March 2026, the company sold packaged beef processed from non-Omi Beef meat on its own online store using the protected name “Omi Beef,” while maintaining a system unable to verify the meat's origin. MAFF determined that this constituted prohibited geographical-indication use under Article 3(2). The order requires immediate checks of relevant products, packaging, advertising, price lists and transaction documents; removal of unlawful indications or registration marks; investigation of causes; preventive measures and staff awareness; and a report to the Minister within one month. The announcement also records separate instructions under Article 6(1) of the Food Labeling Act (Act No. 70 of 2013) and a recommendation under Article 18(2) of the Act on Special Measures Concerning the Management and Relay of Information for Individual Identification of Cattle (Act No. 72 of 2003). Original title: 特定農林水産物等の名称の保護に関する法律に基づく措置命令について Government Announcement | Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) | Published 2026-11-13 | First detected 2026-11-14 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: MAFF recommendation to Apple Sansho over incorrect or missing cattle identification labels
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-13, the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) announced a corrective recommendation to Apple Sansho Co., Ltd. following findings by its Hokuriku Regional Agricultural Administration Bureau. Beef processed at the company's Sakaemachi store was sold to consumers with incorrect cattle identification numbers: at least 34 packs during October 23–November 19, 2025, and three packs on September 16–17, 2026; at least 870 g was sold without identification numbers on November 20–21, 2025. MAFF determined that these sales violated Article 15(1) of the Act on Special Measures Concerning Management and Transmission of Information for Individual Identification of Cattle (Act No. 72 of 2003), commonly called the Beef Traceability Act. The recommendation under Article 18(2) calls for checking existing stock and correcting labels before sale, investigating causes, clarifying responsibilities, improving management and product-control systems, and educating all officers and employees. It also calls for a report on the measures taken to be submitted to the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries by December 14, 2026. Original title: 株式会社アップルサンショウにおける牛の個体識別番号の不適正表示に対する措置について Government Announcement | Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) | Published 2026-11-13 | First detected 2026-11-14 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation.
